meta.description: Add Discord bot channel integration via Chat SDK.

copy.tagline: 集成 Discord 机器人频道到你的应用
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在应用中添加 Discord 机器人消息通道。
copy.tagline_en: Integrate Discord bot channels into your app
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to add a Discord bot channel to your application.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 能把 Discord 机器人频道接入 NanoClaw:自动复制并注册适配器、安装依赖、构建并跑测试,再引导你完成 Discord 机器人创建、填 Bot Token、邀请进服务器等步骤。
howto.when: 当你说要添加 Discord 机器人频道、把 Discord 接入 NanoClaw,或正在 /setup 流程需要接入频道时触发。

say.text: 帮我把 Discord 机器人频道加到 NanoClaw。
say.note: 开始执行适配器复制、注册、构建与测试流程。

say.text: 我要接入 Discord,接下来怎么操作?
say.note: 引导你创建机器人并粘贴 Bot Token。

say.text: 添加 Discord 频道,并注册为聊天渠道。
say.note: 执行 Apply 步骤,并提示你提供令牌等凭据。

howto.what_en: Adds Discord bot channel integration via Chat SDK: copies the Discord adapter from the channels branch, registers it, installs the pinned adapter package, builds and runs the integration test, then guides the user through bot creation, token paste, invite, and DM resolution.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to add a Discord bot channel, integrate Discord into NanoClaw, or is in the /setup flow needing channel wiring.

say_en.text: Help me add the Discord bot channel to NanoClaw.
say_en.note: Starts the adapter copy, registration, build and test steps.

say_en.text: I want to connect Discord. What do I do next?
say_en.note: Guides you through creating the bot and pasting the Bot Token.

say_en.text: Add a Discord channel and register it as a chat channel.
say_en.note: Runs the apply steps and prompts for the token and credentials.
